data.change_summary: Split periphyton and decomposer biomass from single lumped pools into per-habitat BTreeMap<HabitatKind, f64> pools across all 5 habitats (FilterMedia, GlassHardscape, PlantSurfaces, SubstrateSurface, SubstrateDeep). Periphyton growth in algae_growth.rs now iterates per-habitat with independent light factors, capacity, and loss calculations. Decomposer kinetics in nitrogen_cycle.rs distribute growth/decay proportionally using per-habitat oxygen exposure weighting. Grazing (shrimp, microfauna) draws from all habitat pools proportionally via shared remove_periphyton_proportionally(). Save schema bumped to v11 with serde(default) migration. Invariants validate all per-habitat values are non-negative. 10 dedicated tests cover split correctness, conservation, growth divergence, grazing targeting, save/load roundtrip, and habitat diversity effects.
outstanding_risks: Grazing is still proportional across all habitats rather than habitat-aware (shrimp should preferentially graze glass/substrate, not filter media). TODO markers added for future habitat-aware grazing phase.
Nitrifier biomass (AOB, NOB, comammox) remains lumped and not split by habitat. Filter media should carry the majority of nitrifiers in a future pass.

Per-habitat nutrient consumption draws from a shared well-mixed water column. In reality filter media decomposers access nutrients through water flow, not diffusion - this is an acceptable simplification for now.

steps.description: Add per-habitat biomass pools to AlgaeState (periphyton_by_habitat: BTreeMap<HabitatKind, f64>) and MicrobeState (decomposer_by_habitat: BTreeMap<HabitatKind, f64>) in biology.rs, with sync/set/distribute methods and ecologically-weighted affinity functions (light-driven for periphyton, flow+oxygen-driven for decomposers)
Add ensure_habitat_pools() to TankState (state.rs) called from refresh_habitat_registry(), distributing lumped totals into per-habitat maps when maps are empty (migration/first-run path)

Rewrite periphyton growth in algae_growth.rs from single aggregate calculation to per-habitat loop: each habitat independently computes capacity (area × g/m²), light factor (habitat light_exposure × hardware intensity), growth, respiration, grazing, and excess shedding, then syncs total
Rewrite decomposer kinetics in nitrogen_cycle.rs to compute per-habitat effective biomass (biomass × habitat O2 modifier), distribute growth/decay proportionally back to habitat pools, and sync total

Add remove_periphyton_proportionally() in microfauna.rs and use it from both microfauna grazing and shrimp feeding (shrimp.rs) to draw periphyton proportionally from all habitat pools with TODO markers for future habitat-aware grazing
Update engine.rs filter maintenance setback to apply decomposer reduction across per-habitat pools instead of lumped total
Bump save schema to v11 with no-op migration (serde(default) handles empty maps; post-load ensure_habitat_pools distributes lumped totals)
Add invariant validation for all per-habitat periphyton and decomposer values (non-negative check) in invariants.rs
Update all test fixtures and existing tests to use set_periphyton_total()/set_decomposer_total() instead of direct field assignment, ensuring habitat pool consistency

Create habitat_biomass_pools.rs test suite with 10 tests: periphyton split, decomposer split, habitat growth rate divergence (glass >> filter), total biomass conservation on split, grazing targets proportionally, save/load roundtrip, decomposer filter > glass, 500-hour lit-surface preference integration, habitat split conservation, habitat diversity supports more microbes

validation_evidence: All 10 habitat_biomass_pools tests pass: test_periphyton_split_by_habitat, test_decomposer_split_by_habitat, test_habitat_growth_rate_differs, test_total_biomass_conserved_on_split, test_grazing_targets_habitat_periphyton, test_save_load_habitat_pools, test_decomposer_filter_media_exceeds_glass, test_200hr_lit_surface_periphyton_preference, test_habitat_split_conservation, test_habitat_diversity_supports_more_microbes
Full test suite passes: 216 tests across 15 test binaries, 0 failures
cargo fmt --check clean: no formatting issues
AC: glass periphyton grows faster than filter media (test_habitat_growth_rate_differs: glass >> filter after 30 days, filter declines below 0.1 starting value)
AC: decomposer activity in filter media exceeds glass (test_decomposer_filter_media_exceeds_glass: filter > glass after 14 days due to higher flow/O2)

AC: 500-hour integration shows lit surfaces dominate periphyton while filter is decomposer/nitrifier-dominated (test_200hr_lit_surface_periphyton_preference: glass > filter, substrate > filter, filter periphyton < 0.1 starting)

AC: conservation verified - splitting by habitat does not create or destroy biomass (test_total_biomass_conserved_on_split, test_habitat_split_conservation: sum of habitat pools == lumped total within 1e-12)
AC: save/load roundtrip preserves all per-habitat values (test_save_load_habitat_pools: all 5 habitats × both pool types survive JSON serialization)
AC: habitat diversity supports more microbes (test_habitat_diversity_supports_more_microbes: diverse tank > bare glass tank after 500 hours)
